shared_elements: human figure(s) rendered in low relief
horizontal register band beneath the figural scene
repeated small motifs/signs in a band
justification: Both surfaces depict robed human figures in shallow relief with a figural zone set above a horizontal band of repeated small elements (a rosette frieze in A, rows of signs in B), and both use flat outlined bodies with minimal internal modelling. But A shows only the lower body of a large striding/standing figure within a monumental multi-figure frieze with no legible sign-writing, whereas B shows a complete two-figure confrontation across an offering stand plus extensive lines of pictographic script, so the actual scenes and their internal relationships do not correspond.
